text:
incident-bot: ALERT: authz-service error spike (5xx) — 120 errors in last 5m. paging oncall @priya. link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/1809991111
Alex B.: acked. seeing a surge of `signature verification failed` in authz. customers hitting failures when creating sessions. temp mitigation?
Priya S.: taking. oncall now. quick hypothesis: something in key rotation? or noisy synthetic probes flooding logs.
Mike L.: i'm pulling logs — lots of entries with user_agent=\"synthetic-checker/1.2\" and path=/internal/probe. those shouldn't trigger paging.
Alex B.: can we suppress those from the alert first, then investigate root cause? want to avoid more pages if it's probes.
Priya S.: agree. i can roll a temporary rule change: add exclusions for user_agent and path and deploy to alerting. will post the patch here.
Elaine R.: fyi some customers (enterprise-a, partner-x) reported 502s on session create earlier, might be real. check traces for real-user impact before silencing.
Priya S.: good call. i'm checking traces now. preliminary: 70% of the errors correlate with synthetic-checker UA, 30% are real. but the real ones are transient retries that succeed. customer-facing impact limited so far.
Priya S.: mitigation plan: 1) update log-based alert query to exclude known synthetic probes; 2) add a signature to group this noise; 3) relax immediate page threshold to reduce churn while we investigate; 4) instrument authz to count probe vs real errors.
Alex B.: please paste the before/after query so oncall handover is clear.
Priya S.: before:
```
service: \"authz\" AND level: \"error\" AND message: /signature verification failed/ | count() by message
```
after (temporary):
```
service: \"authz\" AND level: \"error\" AND message: /signature verification failed/ 
  AND NOT user_agent =~ /synthetic|healthcheck|probe/ 
  AND NOT path =~ /^\/internal\/(probe|healthz)/ | count() by message
```
Priya S.: i'm going to add a signature `authz:synthetic-probe` that we can use to mute and track noise separately. deploying change to alert rule now.
ops-bot: deploy started for alert-rule/authz-noise-filter (id: ar-4421)
Priya S.: deployed. monitor for next 10m. lowering paging threshold from 50->150 in 5m while we observe.
Alex B.: created a quick dashboard tile to show probe vs non-probe error split: link: https://dash.redwood/s/xyz
Mike L.: confirming reduction in pages already — errors down to ~25 relevant errors in last 5m. most remaining are real users hitting expired keys.
Elaine R.: opened a follow-up ticket to audit key rotation and improve metrics: RW-4321. assigning to Elaine R.
Elaine R.: will add a metric `authz.synthetic_probe` and a test that sends synthetic UA explicitly so it won't pollute production errors.
Priya S.: handing off to Shaun for night coverage. Shaun, main actions: monitor RW-4321 progress, ensure alert rule stays filtered, and if real-user error rate >100 in 10m escalate.
Shaun (oncall): taking handoff. noted thresholds and ticket. i'll keep an eye for any customer escalations.
incident-bot: ACK registered for @Shaun (oncall). reminder set for 02:00 UTC to check error-rate.
Alex B.: post-incident next steps: write short postmortem, include the regex filter we used, add the new signature to log docs, and consider making probe traffic emit `probe=true` field to avoid ad-hoc filters.
Priya S.: will draft the postmortem and include sample rule diffs. scheduled follow-up with eng-api and infra for key rotation audit.
Mike L.: small note: matched logs had stacktrace snippet `kv: lookup failed: key not found` — might be a separate class. tagging RW-4321 for investigation.
Elaine R.: thanks team. no further pages for 20m. moving RW-4321 to in-progress.
Shaun (oncall): i'll update the oncall playbook with the temporary alert exclusion and the signature name so future oncalls know the knob.
Alex B.: closing thread — set to monitor cycle. good job everyone :thumbsup:
